decisions.reason: The quote mentions 'three homozygous patients with neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis-11 (CLN-11)' but does not establish that GRN mutations cause CLN-11. The sentence simply describes patient characteristics, noting that some GRN carriers (who are homozygous) have CLN-11. This is insufficient to support a causal relationship from GRN to the disease. The abstract does not explicitly state that GRN mutations cause CLN-11; it only notes that these homozygous carriers have CLN-11. A causal statement would require explicit language like 'GRN mutations cause CLN-11' or similar.

The quote directly states that 'Levels of LGL1, LSM18:1 and LSM509 were increased in GRN carriers compared to non-carriers (p < 0.0001).' This establishes a clear association between the molecule LGL1 and GRN mutation status. The increased levels in GRN carriers represent an empirically observed association.
